rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides application management for the Hellō identity and SSO platform. Supports creating applications, updating configurations, generating OAuth client secrets, and uploading logos with automatic light/dark theme support. All operations include complete developer context including profile, teams, and applications. Supports both local (stdio) and remote (HTTP) transports.
